objective: Define the production website resolver before building it.

roles.name: Resolver Service Architect
roles.owns: Request/response shape, cache-ready envelope, redirect policy, and service boundary.

roles.name: Security Guard
roles.owns: Allowed/blocked schemes, SSRF controls, max pages, page size, timeout, blocked-domain handling, and no-write proof.

roles.name: Website Intelligence Agent
roles.owns: Evidence extraction fields and failure-state behavior.

roles.name: Regression Guard Agent
roles.owns: Validator gates proving no writes, no SuiteScript, notes cannot own identity, and failures cannot guess.

body.fetchStatus: fetched | blocked | unavailable | timeout | thin | ambiguous
body.extractedEvidence: page title, meta, headings, nav, product/category terms, industry language, ecommerce/manufacturing/distribution/location/service signals
body.signals: lane candidates, product seed, product family, demand moment
body.failureState: blocked | thin | unavailable | ambiguous | timeout | null
body.cache: cache key, ttl seconds, content hashes
body.noRegression: no SuiteScript, no write authority, no hidden lane override, notes cannot own identity

urlNormalization.httpPolicy: allow only when immediately upgraded or redirected to https; otherwise return blocked

ssrfControls: block link-local and metadata service IPs
resolve DNS before fetch and after redirects
reject redirect targets that violate scheme or network policy

redirectPolicy.allowed: same registrable domain or public https redirect only

fetchStrategy.fallbackWhenBlocked: return failureState blocked and ask for manual evidence
fetchStrategy.fallbackWhenThin: return failureState thin and ask for homepage/category/product text
fetchStrategy.fallbackWhenUnavailable: return failureState unavailable and allow retry/manual evidence
fetchStrategy.fallbackWhenTimeout: return failureState timeout and allow retry/manual evidence

failureStateMatrix.consultantAction: Paste website/category/product evidence or retry from approved resolver environment.
Paste category/product evidence or confirm the business category.
Retry later or provide manual evidence.
Show competing candidates and require confirmation.

redaction: do not log request body manualEvidence beyond trace-safe excerpt

bestNextCodexPrompt.prompt: Move through W63: Local Resolver Service Prototype. Build the no-write website resolver service outside the drawer using the W62 websiteResolverServiceV1 contract. Implement URL normalization, safety checks, homepage fetch, secondary page discovery, HTML extraction, failure-state responses, cache-ready response fields, synthetic and approved live-fetch harnesses, trace samples, validator gates, and a W63 report. No writes, no SuiteScript invocation, N/LLM advisory-only, notes cannot own identity, and blocked/thin/unavailable/timeout must never produce confident guesses.
